should_fail.message: I've added an illustration to slide 2.

slides.content_brief: Three short bullets: a passkey only works on the real site, so a fake sign-in page gets nothing; there is no secret to reuse or leak; the private key never leaves the device. Close with a callout: a passkey cannot be phished Show {{image:OxLbbEzAykslUBOdOhF-xclBBb17YdyYjQfSuZx2Y2c}} beside the bullets.
slides.assumes: The audience has seen a phishing email that asked for a password
slides.hands_off: Passkeys remove the thing attackers steal
